items.title: Meta expands subscription push with new AI-focused plans
items.feed_excerpt: Meta One bundles expanded access to the company’s AI tools with premium features across Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp.

items.title: India ends free ride for larger transactions on its ubiquitous digital payments network
items.feed_excerpt: India will impose a 0.4% merchant fee on certain payments made through UPI starting October 15.

items.title: Early Anthropic hire, former METR COO have found a way to rein in rogue AI agents
items.feed_excerpt: Their startup, Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company (AIUC) has raised $40 million in a Series A round led by Ribbit Capital, with participation from First Harmonic.

items.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
items.feed_excerpt: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.

items.title: US data centers could consume more natural gas than Germany and Japan combined by 2035
items.feed_excerpt: The AI frenzy could push U.S. data centers to become one of the largest consumers of natural gas in the world.

items.title: AI agents now have a place to snitch
items.feed_excerpt: The AI Contact Hotline is designed to be a discreet place where agents that have witnessed misbehavior can tip off authorities.

items.title: The AI data center boom is colliding with cities scarred by big industry
items.feed_excerpt: National outcry against data center construction has spread to Philadelphia, where officials suggested possible construction in a neighborhood already impacted by a now-defunct oil refinery.
